study.question: Does the direction-free auxiliary feature retain useful same-row cross-field overlap information, or is its apparent utility explained by support alone or by timestamp ties without a shared-row witness?
study.hypothesis: Provisional mechanism hypothesis: the folded latest-activity comparison confounds chronology with observation-level cross-field overlap. For gate g, latest receiving age c, crossed match anchor age a, T=g*1[c=a], and J=T*1[one supplied row belongs to both receiving-activity and selected-anchor cohorts at age a], define D=T-J. The folded input is exactly0.5*(g-0.5*T). J carries incremental predictive evidence while D adds little or harms conditioning. Replacing T by J may preserve or improve validation AUC without a new parameter. This is an untested local mechanism, not a verified scientific novelty claim.

nearest_work.difference: DIN local activation and embedding/MLP structure are inherited via an adapted normalized category/brand reference. The primary paper explicitly removes softmax normalization; this task reference retains normalization and is not an exact DIN reproduction. Our difference is a deterministic, shared-row-aware tie decomposition in the last8 inputs, not a new local activation architecture.

Only author README available/read; publisher full paper blocked, so detailed mechanism comparison unresolved. README states histories supply category/brand/action but no item. Shared supplied rows are used without inventing item identities; no DMR reproduction claimed.

Nearest local feature: max(r,g-r)=g-0.5*T, where r is the ordinal comparison. ties_both reproduces this exact tensor using the inherited latest/activity helper. New contrasts retain/remove disjoint shared-row J and remaining D components, rather than comparing direction or time-ratio magnitude.

Own-arm receipt tests target category AND target brand match counts/decayed masses; it did not exceed support_pair. Current J does not require the receiving field to match its target, uses the latest/selected-anchor cohort and fixed later support, and replaces8 existing inputs. That earlier negative result constrains enthusiasm but is not a matched refutation of this different statistic.

predictions: Implementation prediction: T=J+D, J*D=0, J<=T<=g; J must vanish on fallback-only support. Keeping both exactly equals historical folded ordinal; no inputs outside inherited gate or with missing/empty history; all variants share parameter shapes and initial state.

Primary directional prediction using full validation AUC A_jd: shared-row effects A10-A00>0 and A11-A01>0; remaining-tie effects A11-A10<=0 and A01-A00<=0. These are prospective sign predictions, not an equivalence or significance threshold. Opposite effects imply interaction and block a simple J-only account.

If J explains the useful component, ties_joint should outperform support-only and residual-only and be competitive with ties_both and historical oriented parent0.6201924719712801; verify later paired seeds42/43/44 before claiming repeated support. A gain over ties_both alone does not establish chronology or event identity.

falsifiers: J has no observed support, identity failures, nonfinite logits or support/anchor drift: implementation/identifiability failure; do not interpret as scientific mechanism evidence.

Support-only performs as well as all tie variants on repeated paired validation, or J effects are nonpositive: incremental shared-row hypothesis unsupported; do not call a single-seed small gap evidence of equivalence.

Residual-only exceeds shared-row-only and residual effects are positive across both J levels: contradicts the proposed shared-row explanation. Mixed signs require interaction/redundancy analysis rather than a one-component claim.

Folded reproduction does not recover historical ordinal_folded under the same host seed/recipe: investigate arithmetic/execution before interpreting any contrast; no automatic duplicate testing after unknown execution state.
